source: NOID_Bahamas_1984_25Cents_obv.jpg (owner chat 2026-10-12); Numista N#9352 (https://en.numista.com/catalogue/pieces9352.html): 25 cents, KM#63.1, 24.26mm, round

new.story: A 1984 Bahamian 25 cent piece with the national coat of arms — the Santa Maria ship, a flamingo and blue marlin holding the shield. The motto reads Forward, Upward, Onward Together. The other side shows a Bahamian sloop under sail.
new.notes: Blind double-read. COMMONWEALTH OF THE BAHAMAS / 1984 read from enlargement. Denomination by elimination: round (not scalloped like 10c, not square like 15c), measured ~24.4mm vs 24.26mm (25c) spec.
